prompt: A tattered specter of wine-purple smoke and ragged shadow-cloth hovers in side profile facing south-west, skeletal arm outstretched gripping the throat of an armored human knight whose body is dissolving into drifting black motes and violet ash from the feet upward, unmade into nothing. The knight in dented steel plate, greyish drained human face wide with terror, half-erased. The only light is the cold violet glow of the specter hollow eyes. The background is a lightless crypt of black stone.

A dying specter of ragged violet vapor collapses and dissolves into a swirling black void rift, and as it sinks it drags a snarling green-scaled monster down into the same nothingness with it by a tendril of shadow around the monster's leg. Both fully visible head to knee, the same size. The monster's lower body already erased into drifting ash. The only light is a sickly purple glow at the heart of the void. The background is a barren ashen wasteland under a starless black sky.

Close-up worm's-eye view of an armored human soldier in dented steel plate, his greyish drained human face frozen in horror as his outstretched hand and forearm crumble into floating black motes and violet dust, erased finger by finger into nothing. Behind him looms a faceless shade of wine-purple tatters and two cold glowing eyes, one bony hand resting on the soldier's shoulder. The only light is the violet glow of the shade's eyes. The background is deep crypt shadow.

Wide shot of a looming tattered specter of purple-black smoke hovering over a battlefield, one arm raised, opening a tear of pure black void in the air below it into which a fleeing peasant is being sucked feet-first, half-dissolved into streaming ash. The specter's body trails into wisps with no legs. The only light is a faint violet rim around the void tear. The background is a fog-choked moor at midnight.

A gaunt hooded shade of bone-grey rags and wine-purple shadow grips a struggling armored knight in a deathly embrace, and from where the shade touches him the knight's steel plate and greyish human flesh are turning to crumbling violet ash and blowing away into nothing. Side profile, both figures fully visible. The only light is the cold violet glow leaking from the shade's hood. The background is a ruined black-stone chapel.

A specter made of swirling dark violet smoke and tattered grave-cloth hovers facing the viewer, hands spread wide, as a small human figure in front of it disintegrates into a column of rising black embers and purple ash, erased from existence. The specter has hollow white-violet eyes and no lower body, only trailing vapor. The only light is the glow of the disintegration. The background is a vast empty void of deep indigo and black.

A pierced and fading specter of wine-purple tatters, itself dissolving into smoke at its edges as it dies, reaches one long clawed hand toward a cowering green goblin and unmakes it: the goblin's body is half-gone, scattering into violet motes and shadow. Side profile facing east. The only light is the violet glow of the unmaking. The background is a dim torchless dungeon of wet black stone.

Low angle on a towering wraith of black and deep-purple shrouds, arms outstretched, with two victims at its feet, an armored human and a beast, both being drawn upward and dissolved into a vortex of violet ash and shadow swirling into the wraith's chest, erased into nothing. Both victims fully visible. The only light is the violet vortex glow. The background is a desolate graveyard of leaning headstones.
